text:
tess: Quick note from tonight's usability pass: the inline docs panel heading says "Support Hub" while the console nav says "Developer Docs". Users asked where API guides live.

sam: Oof. That's confusing. We changed labels in the last sprint but not everywhere.

maria: Copy suggestion: canonicalize on "Developer Docs" for API/SDK guides and use "Support Hub" only for billing/troubleshooting pages. Short CTA = "Open in Docs".

zoe: Accessibility: add aria-label to the panel close button, ensure focus returns to the trigger, and avoid ambiguous link text like "Open".

raj: Technical: our /support -> /docs redirect currently drops fragments and utm params. I can update redirect to preserve $request_uri. Need thumbs before patching CDN.

tess: Can we also make the flyout links open a new tab? That would keep users in the console and let them read docs separately.

sam: Good UX. We'll make /docs links target=_blank + rel=noopener for safety.

maria: I'll write a one-paragraph guideline for in-console CTAs and post to RED-450.

zoe: After changes, let's run a quick keyboard-only walkthrough. I'll volunteer.

raj: I'll put the redirect change up for review tomorrow AM.

tess: Thanks all, closing after PR + redirect + a11y check.
